title: Interface Sounds
og_description: Download this package (100 assets) for free, CC0 licensed!
visual_summary: Preview shows a flat, minimal Kenney-style icon: a white circular badge holding a stylized speaker, paired with a dark gray rounded-square cursor tile with a white arrow cursor, all on a bright mint-green background. The aesthetic signals a clean, modern UI/UX sound pack designed for buttons, menus and app interactions.

zip_inventory.notes: All 100 sound files live in a single Audio/ folder; root contains License.txt, Patreon.url and an entry-folder marker.
